nodes.description: A small 8x zoom scope.

The Armored Door, or armoured door, is an extremely strong door with a hatch you can see and shoot out of. Raiding one takes 250 explo ammo, 5 rockets, 15 satchels or 3 C4. Propane bombs take 8 placed by hand or 5 launched from a [catapult](/items/catapult). Craft it at a tier 3 workbench for 20 HQM and 5 [gears](/items/gears) after researching it for 300 [scrap](/items/scrap), or loot one from a [Bradley Crate](/world/bradley-crate) at 30%.

The Armored Double Door is an extremely strong double door with a hatch to see and shoot out of. Raiding one takes 3 C4, 5 rockets, 15 satchels, 250 explosive ammo, or 8 propane bombs placed by hand (5 launched from a [catapult](/items/catapult)). Craft it at a tier 3 workbench for 25 HQM and 5 [gears](/items/gears) once you've researched it for 300 scrap. [Bradley crates](/world/bradley-crate) drop one 15% of the time, and [locked crates](/world/locked-crate) rarely do.

The Armored Ladder Hatch fits in a floor frame and opens into a ladder, and takes a code lock or [key lock](/items/key-lock) to shut off vertical access. Raid cost is 3 C4, 5 rockets or 15 satchels. Craft it at a tier 3 workbench from a [Wooden Ladder](/items/wooden-ladder), 35 HQM and 6 gears. Research costs 100 scrap, or 4 blueprint books total on the tech tree after the [armored double door](/items/armored-double-door). Elite crates and [PT boat](/world/ptboat) dryboxes drop it, but rarely.
A triangular armored hatch that opens and changes into a ladder.

The Assault Rifle, or AK, is a high damage machine rifle. The AK recipe takes a tier 3 workbench, 50 HQM, 200 wood, a [rifle body](/items/rifle-body) and 4 [metal springs](/items/metal-spring), and the blueprint costs 300 scrap to research or 9 blueprint books total through the tech tree. Hackable [Locked Crates](/world/locked-crate) are your best loot shot at around 28%, while Elite and [Heli Crates](/world/heli-crate) rarely drop one. Repairing it needs the blueprint and a Repair Bench, up to 13 HQM and 40 wood.

The Bolt Action Rifle, or bolty, is a high powered, highly accurate long range rifle. Craft it at a tier 3 workbench for 20 HQM, a [rifle body](/items/rifle-body), 3 [metal pipes](/items/metal-pipe) and a [metal spring](/items/metal-spring), with the blueprint at 300 scrap to research or 10 blueprint books total down the tech tree from the AK. Hackable [Locked Crates](/world/locked-crate) drop it about 17% of the time, while other drops are rare. It takes 11 attachments, including Variable Zoom and 8x scopes.

Explosive 5.56 rifle ammo, aka explo ammo, explodes on contact and deals a small amount of fragmentation damage to nearby objects. The reliable way to get it is crafting at a tier 3 workbench, where 10 metal frags, 20 [gun powder](/items/gun-powder) and 10 [sulfur](/items/sulfur) makes 2 rounds. Research costs 100 scrap, or it's 7 blueprint books total on the tech tree past the MP5. [Locked crates](/world/locked-crate) have a 30% chance to drop 30, and [Bradley crates](/world/bradley-crate) a 19% chance at 30-60.
A component used for crafting C4 and Rockets.

The HMLMG, or HMLG, is a hand made belt-fed LMG with high damage and fire rate but low accuracy during short bursts. The reliable route is a tier 3 workbench: 30 HQM, a [rifle body](/items/rifle-body), 3 springs and 2 [gears](/items/gears), after 300 scrap of research or 8 blueprint books on the tech tree. The [Travelling Vendor](/world/travelling-vendor) sometimes sells one for around 309 scrap, and it's a rare drop from locked crates, elite crates and [PT boat](/world/ptboat) dryboxes.
This ammunition travels faster, resulting in less drop and slightly higher damage when fired over long distances.
Slower moving ammunition that deals fire damage. There's a small chance it will start a fire.
A metal plate covering your torso, provides excellent protection from all forms of attacks.

The Metal Facemask gives you excellent head protection against every kind of attack, and it can be skinned. Craft it at a tier 3 workbench for 50 [leather](/items/leather), 15 HQM and 6 [sewing kits](/items/sewing-kit), after researching it for 300 scrap or unlocking it past the MP5 in the tech tree for 7 blueprint books total. Hackable [locked crates](/world/locked-crate) drop it about half the time, while elite crates, [heli crates](/world/heli-crate) and heavy scientists only drop it rarely.

The MP5A4, or MP5, is a medium damage machine gun you craft at a tier 3 workbench for 15 HQM, an [SMG body](/items/smg-body) and 2 [metal springs](/items/metal-spring). Research is 300 scrap, or 6 blueprint books total on the tech tree. [Supply drops](/world/supply-drop) are the best loot source at about 18%, then locked crates, including [Oil Rig](/monument/oil-rig)'s, at 5.6%. A Green Recycler returns 7 HQM, a spring and a 50% shot at an SMG body.

The Reinforced Glass Window is the armored window insert for a standard window, with reinforced metal bars and a thick surround to protect you from incoming projectiles. Craft it at a tier 3 workbench for 4 HQM, once you've researched it for 100 [scrap](/items/scrap) or unlocked it on the tech tree for 1 [blueprint book](/items/blueprint-book). Taking one out costs 2 C4, 4 rockets or 12 satchels. It's also a rare drop from [Locked Crates](/world/locked-crate) and Elite Crates.

Rockets are the ammo for the [Rocket Launcher](/items/rocket-launcher), unguided with large splash damage on impact. One rocket costs 150 gunpowder, 10 explosives and 2 metal pipes at a tier 3 workbench. Those explosives take another 500 gunpowder, so it's 650 GP per rocket all in, or 1400 [sulfur](/items/sulfur) and 1950 charcoal from raw. Research is 100 scrap. [Heli crates](/world/heli-crate) have a 25% chance of 3 rockets, and [locked crates](/world/locked-crate) rarely drop one.

The SKS is a military-grade semi-auto rifle on 5.56, and crafting is the reliable way to get one: a tier 3 workbench, a [Semi Automatic Body](/items/semi-automatic-body), 2 [metal springs](/items/metal-spring), 200 frags and 12 HQM. The blueprint costs 100 scrap to research or 2 [blueprint books](/items/blueprint-book) total through the tier 3 tech tree. Loot drops are rare, topping out around 5.6% in [Locked Crates](/world/locked-crate). Repair it at a Repair Bench once you know the blueprint, and it has skins.

C4 is the Timed Explosive Charge, the raid explosive for breaking into bases. To make C4 you need a tier 3 workbench plus 20 explosives, 5 cloth and 2 [tech trash](/items/tech-trash). Research it for 300 scrap, or unlock it on the tier 3 tech tree for 9 blueprint books total. It also drops from [Bradley crates](/world/bradley-crate) (36%, 1-2 at a time), [supply drops](/world/supply-drop) (about 27%, 1-2) and [heli crates](/world/heli-crate) (25%, always 2).
Attaches to a weapon. Provides user with a guiding laser and reduces weapon sway.
